scope.purpose: Freeze the existing instruction, query, action, objective, effect, authority, durable execution, truth, projection, and replay substrate without adding product intelligence or a second execution architecture.

nodes.label: Durable Work/Input claim
nodes.truth: works and work_inputs are committed before routing enrichment or planning; instruction_sessions is a compatibility trace projection

nodes.label: Routing, context, and grounding
nodes.truth: One of QUERY, CONVERSATION, ATOMIC_ACTION, OBJECTIVE, or CLARIFY; preliminary atomic routing is revalidated against the typed plan

nodes.label: Current execution model
nodes.truth: QUERY runs a typed canonical read, CONVERSATION runs the answer responder, ATOMIC_ACTION plans one typed action, CLARIFY emits one clarification action, and OBJECTIVE starts the durable objective loop

nodes.label: Typed plan / DomainAction
nodes.truth: Validated plugin action type, grounded_payload, compiled_graph, plan dependency ids, and policy revision are persisted together

nodes.label: Immutable BusinessEffect
nodes.truth: A consequential DomainAction owns one frozen semanticHash and scopeHash before authority, approval, or execution

nodes.label: Authority and approval
nodes.truth: The actor, authority revision, policy revision, approval floor, effect id, and semantic hash are bound to the authorization episode

nodes.label: Durable Work / execution
nodes.truth: Consequential actions execute from an authorized command/workflow step and the frozen effect delta, never from a later mutable request payload

nodes.label: Provider, computer, or internal mutation
nodes.truth: Action-level tools use external_operations; workflow CapabilityContracts use integration_operations; computer writes use computer_runs and an exact authorizedEffect

nodes.label: Observation and reconciliation
nodes.truth: Provider acknowledgement remains awaiting_observation; unknown delivery opens reconciliation and cannot be blindly retried

nodes.label: Verification
nodes.truth: BusinessEffect, objective, workflow, and computer completion retain the evidence required by their current verification contract

nodes.label: Receipt, Work projection, and causal replay
nodes.truth: Backend durable rows are canonical; frontend/realtime surfaces are bounded read-only projections and replay is reconstructed without mutation

branchExceptions.QUERY: Branches after query_conversation_action_objective to canonical query execution, then directly to receipt_projection_replay; it creates no DomainAction or BusinessEffect.
branchExceptions.CONVERSATION: Branches after query_conversation_action_objective to the conversation responder, then directly to receipt_projection_replay; it records a planner-attempt lifecycle row but does not call Planner.plan.
branchExceptions.OBJECTIVE: Persists work_objective_loops and repeatedly re-enters typed query/action execution until an evidence-backed success condition or another terminal state.
branchExceptions.READ_ONLY_DOMAIN_ACTION: A planned read-only plugin action may execute synchronously through GatedExecutor without a BusinessEffect because isConsequentialAction is false.

executionModels.name: QUERY
executionModels.entryCondition: fastReadDecision.route is fast_read or an explicit typed OperationalQueryRequest enters handleOperationalQuery
executionModels.work: received -> understanding -> executing -> completed, with execution_model=query
executionModels.completion: canonical result and metadata are durably stored and Work.final_outcome.kind=operational_query
executionModels.failure: Work failed with a bounded, non-fabricated query failure
executionModels.replayProjection: duplicate intake replays the stored query; query result source.kind=canonical_postgres

executionModels.name: CONVERSATION
executionModels.entryCondition: isConversationalTurn or a lightweight informational question outside business mutation/research grammar
executionModels.planner: Planner.plan absent; beginWorkPlannerAttempt is used as the existing durable attempt envelope
executionModels.work: received -> understanding -> planning -> ready -> executing -> completed; current route persists works.execution_model=conversation (legacy rows may remain null)
executionModels.authority: no action authority decision; authenticated intake remains required
executionModels.execution: ConversationResponder.answer with empty memory for the direct route; empty-plan recovery may use already assembled memory
executionModels.completion: answer envelope is recorded in Work final outcome and instruction trace
executionModels.failure: planner-attempt marked failed/timed_out and Work failed
executionModels.replayProjection: Work/instruction trace projects the answer; no BusinessEffect or DecisionReceipt is fabricated

executionModels.name: ATOMIC_ACTION
executionModels.entryCondition: strict single-effect candidate and typed plan finalization proves one independent consequential single_action
executionModels.planner: Planner.plan validates registered plugin schema, grounds ids, simulates, and persists one DomainAction
executionModels.work: received -> understanding -> planning -> ready -> actionable -> awaiting_approval or executing -> completed/failed/recovery
executionModels.authority: GatedExecutor evaluates action authority before approval/execution; final approval and execution revalidate current authority
executionModels.execution: BusinessEffect -> exact approval -> single_action command/workflow step -> durable worker -> plugin/tool/internal mutation
executionModels.completion: child reconciliation completes Work only after the action/workflow/operation reaches current terminal evidence rules
executionModels.failure: typed failure, integration unavailable, unknown/reconciliation, or recovery without false completion
executionModels.replayProjection: DecisionReceipt, execution projection, operational deltas, and causal replay reference the same Work/action/effect

executionModels.name: CLARIFY
executionModels.entryCondition: deterministic reference/sender resolution is consequentially ambiguous, or typed planning emits clarification_request
executionModels.planner: Planner may produce one clarification_request; no BusinessEffect is created
executionModels.work: received -> understanding -> planning -> ready -> actionable -> completed through the clarification action contract
executionModels.authority: authenticated intake and tenant-scoped resolution remain required; no consequential authority approval is requested
executionModels.execution: HumanOperatingCompiler compiles the clarification route and the existing action projection records the clarification request
executionModels.completion: exactly one clarification_request DomainAction is persisted with no BusinessEffect
executionModels.failure: route-contract violation fails planning visibly; no business mutation is attempted
executionModels.replayProjection: Work/action trace projects the clarification request without a BusinessEffect or verified business outcome

executionModels.name: OBJECTIVE
executionModels.entryCondition: objective signal/default meaningful business work, or preliminary atomic route rejected by the typed plan
executionModels.planner: initial objective route creates no DomainAction; each durable iteration inspects canonical truth and may issue one typed query/action decision
executionModels.authority: each query/action/computer step uses current authority; wake/resume revalidates the actor and referenced tenant resources
executionModels.execution: leased objective iterations, durable event waits, typed actions, commands/workflows, and restart recovery
executionModels.completion: objective-success verifier records successVerification and successVerifiedAt before completed
executionModels.failure: bounded budgets, planner failures, deadline, block, cancellation, or recovery remain explicit
executionModels.replayProjection: Work aggregate, objective steps, receipts, waits, callbacks, projection, and causal replay reconstruct the loop

compatibilityAndLegacySeams.reality: Backward-compatible instruction trace; new intake always creates canonical Work/Input first.
CONVERSATION is a real route and current migration 0105 permits/persists conversation; older rows may retain null execution_model and remain a compatibility seam.
Injected routers without the typed interpret/execute seam may return an answer; canonical deployments use typed Operational Query Plane.
AllowlistExecutor selects LangGraphExecutor for configured action types and GatedExecutor otherwise; both converge on the same runtime bridge and effect boundary.
Action tool calls and workflow CapabilityContracts keep distinct durable operation identity domains.
workflow_states tracks business stage; workflow_runs/workflow_steps own durable execution.
Voice confirmation transport mirrors canonical authority approval/action decision.
Still a registered canonical reference and bounded fallback; calls/messages/communication_deliveries own newer provider-specific truth.
Two current schedule representations serve historical service visits and canonical typed appointments; query plane reads both.
inventory_items is tenant-default stock; warehouse_stock is multi-location stock; inventory queries expose both with source labels.
Household remains the account/customer row and contains a bounded contact summary while contacts/contact_methods own structured people/channels.
createLead immediately creates/links a household; schema comments explicitly retain this dual-write compromise.
Zep is additive and non-authoritative; pgvector/Zep hits deduplicate and never replace structured truth.

Authenticated dispatch, technician, provider-webhook, and lifecycle workers contain bounded direct canonical mutations outside the natural-language DomainAction compiler. P0 freezes and inventories these callsites; migrating them to BusinessEffects would be a semantic architecture change deferred beyond P0.
Rebuildable caches, operational deltas, Work cases, execution projection, and causal replay never own lifecycle/business writes.

deferredBeyondP0: Unify or explicitly translate DomainAction, CapabilityContract, and Tool capability identities in later compiler work.
Decide whether authenticated manual operational endpoints should compile BusinessEffects; do not retrofit them during the freeze.
Retire or migrate legacy instruction_sessions, communications_log, household contact summaries, and service_visits only through a separately approved migration.
Define one future epistemic runtime by extending OPERATING_TRUTH_PRECEDENCE and SourceOwnershipPolicy rather than introducing another context/truth owner.
Normalize action-level external_operations and workflow integration_operations only with an explicit idempotency-domain migration.
Revisit the LangGraph allowlist/legacy executor split without changing the shared governed runtime boundary.
Resolve the stale operational-query comment that says eight intents while the actual canonical registry contains thirteen.
Move remaining sanctioned direct canonical mutation callsites behind clearer data-platform functions without changing their present semantics.
